verdicts.reason: Both use the same flawed structure: the CTA sits at the top of the right column above the badges, which breaks the reading order, and the body copy is pushed into the bottom-right corner, away from the headline. A keeps the product inside its circle as in the original, and its headline sets cleanly in two lines. B breaks the headline into three lines, leaving 'back' as an orphan, and shrinks the circle so the shoe spills past it on the left; its body copy is also crammed against the bottom edge.
